description: Use this when the user wants ALL the work spots in one area (e.g. "everything in the Arts District"). Returns the zone and a compact list of its spots with slugs and urls.

slug.description: Zone slug, name or alias: a quadrant (central, northwest, northeast, southwest, southeast), an area (e.g. the-strip, downtown, arts-district, chinatown, summerlin, henderson) or a landmark waypoint. See list_zones.

name: get_zone
title: List every spot in one zone
